WEEK_PLAN.focus: Phase 0 — Calibration: MIT finals, Stat 110, coding diagnostic, GitHub/blog/X, earning offer
Micrograd: build backprop from scratch, rebuild blind · NeetCode Arrays & Hashing · fast.ai L1 · first blog post
Makemore 1–2: bigrams → MLP (Bengio 2003) · Two Pointers, Sliding Window · fast.ai L2–3
Makemore 3–4: BatchNorm, backprop ninja (do not skip) · Stack, Binary Search · fast.ai L4–5
Makemore 5 + Let's build GPT: attention, the transformer · Linked List, Trees · fast.ai L6–7
Tokenizer + consolidation: reproduce full GPT pipeline with zero reference · Trees · fast.ai L8
First original project: train a small GPT on YOUR dataset (Arabic corpus?) · Heap, Backtracking
nanoGPT line by line + PyTorch depth: profile, improve, mixed precision · Graphs
Month-6 gate review: rebuild GPT blind, timed · count everything · fill the gate
Phase 2 opens — MATH 210 matrix calculus · Paper 1: AlexNet, reimplement + train on CIFAR-10 · CS336 begins
Paper 2: ResNet — CIFAR-10 ≥93% lab · MATH 210 optimization unit · first open-source issue triage
Paper 3: Attention Is All You Need — transformer from the paper alone · MacKay information theory begins
Paper 4: BERT · SYS 250 opens — CMU 10-714, build the framework's autograd
SYS 250 deep block: NDArray backend + GPU acceleration · Papers 5–6: GPT-2, ViT · CUDA matmul lab
Papers 7–9: CLIP, Chinchilla, FlashAttention · GPU MODE kernels · open-source sprint #1 — first merged PR
AI 310 block: CS336 end-to-end LM · Papers 10–12: LLaMA, LoRA, InstructGPT · LoRA finetune lab
AI 310: evals + inference · Papers 13–14: DPO, Mixtral/MoE · eval-harness + inference-API labs
Papers 15–16: DDPM, RAG · open-source sprint #2 · agent-with-tools lab · Gate 3 material complete
Consolidation: rebuild 3 papers blind · portfolio pass · choose the fork — Gate 4 decision
Phase 3 — the fork: RES 400 on your chosen track (researcher: interp + RL · engineer: systems + scale · founder: ship + revenue). Weekly pattern: 1 frontier paper, 1 shipped artifact, 1 public post.
